mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as rising demand boosts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <30% of GDPC1-up quarters, or negative returns when GDPC1 rises but other factors dominate.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% per annum, S&P 500 20-day forward returns turn negative due to anticipated rate hikes tightening financial conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0%, or positive returns despite high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly rises in GDPC1 (demand) above 5% and INDPRO (supply) above 2.5% trigger positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns as expanded demand and production capacity boost market confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.05 over 60d horizon when both proxies rise, or positive returns without both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, falling UNRATE below 6.0% per annum predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as improved labor conditions boost corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when UNRATE <6% in late-cycle regime, or negative returns despite falling UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in INDPRO (supply) above 2.5% predicts positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as robust production signals economic strength.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not positive in >60% of INDPRO-up months, or negative returns despite high INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE crosses above 7.0% per annum, S&P 500 60-day forward returns turn negative due to expectations of tighter labor markets and higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 7%, or positive returns despite high UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% and UNRATE below 6.5% trigger positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as dual easing signals reduced policy constraints and labor market stability.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when both FEDFUNDS <1.5% and UNRATE <6.5%, or negative returns despite dual easing.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, HOUST (demand) exceeding 700 units monthly predicts positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns as rising demand indicates economic bottoming out.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not positive when HOUST >700 in post-shock regime, or negative returns despite high HOUST.
